annotations.title: Check an EPUB file with EPUBCheck

description:
Check an EPUB file (EPUB 2 or 3) against the EPUB specifications with
EPUBCheck, the W3C's conformance checker.

Input: `epub_base64` is the base64 of the EPUB, at most 4 MB decoded, or
pass the file as a download link in `file`.

Returns `summary` (`valid`, and the `fatal`, `error` and `warning`
counts; `valid` is true when there is no FATAL and no ERROR message),
`messages` (the 20 most severe, FATAL first, each with `severity`, `id`,
`message`, up to three `locations` as `path:line:column`, and a
`suggestion` when EPUBCheck has one), `messages_total` and
`epubcheck_version`. For the full report, or files up to 25 MB, use the
REST API (`POST /v1/epubcheck/check`).

Credits: 2 per call.

epub_base64.description: The EPUB file, base64-encoded. At most 4 MB decoded.

file.description: The file as a download link, instead of `epub_base64`. In ChatGPT, pass the user's uploaded file here. Other clients can set `download_url` to a public https URL.

download_url.description: A public https URL of the file.

file_id.description: An identifier for the file. ChatGPT sets it; other clients may pass any label, such as the file name.
